notice: This registry is a derived application of EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019 with the corrigendum AC:2020 applied: it implements that European Standard. The standard text was obtained free of charge under the European Commission / CEN Licence Agreement of 18 December 2018 as published by the Slovak Office of Standards, Metrology and Testing (ÚNMS SR); reproduction of the standard is with the consent of CEN and ÚNMS SR. The registry itself reproduces no normative prose: identifiers, names, cardinalities and semantic data types are facts of the model, and every description and note in this file is the author's own wording.
sourceStatement: Structure, cardinalities, semantic data types and supplementary components follow EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019/AC:2020, Table 2 and clause 6.5; the order member is the 1-based position in Table 2. maxDecimals follows Table 26 in 6.5.12. Each codeList assignment is justified in the term's notes by a BR-CL rule of the CEN/TC 434 validation artefacts 1.3.16 (EUPL-1.2) or by a Table 2 usage note, or by both. The model was cross-checked against the KoSIT XRechnung semantic-model XSD (Apache-2.0) and against the Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 structure files; no text from those sources is reproduced here. Slugs are an ESJ convention for code generation and carry no normative weight.

terms.name: Invoice number
terms.description: Unique identification of the invoice in the seller's systems; no identification scheme is used.

terms.name: Invoice issue date
terms.description: Date on which the invoice was issued.

terms.name: Invoice type code
terms.description: Code for the functional type of the invoice, taken from UNTDID 1001.
notes: Code list UNTDID 1001. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-3 refers to the entries of UNTDID 1001; CEN rule BR-CL-01 enforces the invoice and credit note subsets of that list.

terms.name: Invoice currency code
terms.description: The currency of every amount in this invoice; BT-111 is the one amount written in the accounting currency instead.
notes: Code list ISO 4217 alpha-3. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-5 refers to the currency lists of the ISO 4217 maintenance agency; CEN rule BR-CL-04 enforces ISO 4217 alpha-3.

terms.name: VAT accounting currency code
terms.description: Currency used for VAT accounting and reporting in the seller's country.
notes: Code list ISO 4217 alpha-3. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-6 refers to the currency lists of the ISO 4217 maintenance agency; CEN rule BR-CL-05 enforces ISO 4217 alpha-3.

terms.name: Value added tax point date
terms.description: Date on which VAT becomes chargeable for seller and buyer (tax point date).

terms.name: Value added tax point date code
terms.description: Code saying which event fixes the VAT tax point date.
notes: Code list UNTDID 2005. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-8 names three entries of UNTDID 2005; CEN rule BR-CL-06 restricts the UBL binding to the values 3, 35 and 432. The CII artefacts phrase the same rule as a restriction of UNTDID 2475.

terms.description: Date by which payment is due.

terms.name: Tender or lot reference

terms.name: Invoiced object identifier

components.name: Invoiced object identifier identification scheme identifier

terms.description: Identifier of an object the invoice is based on, assigned by the seller (e.g. a subscription, meter point or vehicle).
notes: The BT-x-y style is the numbering implementers commonly use for supplementary components. It could not be verified against CEN/TS 16931-3-2 or CEN/TS 16931-3-3, which are outside the free-access licence and were not obtained for this project. EN 16931-1 Table 2 lists the components without an id, so the component id here is an informative label and 'role' is the normative-facing member.

notes: The semantic data type was corrected from Text to Code by EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019/AC:2020, clause 3 (DE9); the uncorrected print of Table 2 still shows Text.
Code list UNTDID 4451. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-21 requires an entry of UNTDID 4451; CEN rule BR-CL-08 enforces a restriction of that list.

terms.name: Invoice total amount with VAT
terms.description: Total invoice amount including VAT.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: Paid amount
terms.description: Amount already paid in advance for this invoice.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: Rounding amount
terms.description: Amount added to round the amount due for payment.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: Amount due for payment
terms.description: Outstanding amount still to be paid.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: VAT BREAKDOWN
terms.description: Group breaking the invoice down by VAT category, rate and exemption reason.

terms.name: VAT category taxable amount
terms.description: Sum of taxable amounts subject to one VAT category and rate.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: VAT category tax amount
terms.description: VAT amount calculated for one VAT category and rate.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: VAT category code
terms.description: Code for the VAT category of this breakdown line, from UNTDID 5305.
notes: Code list UNTDID 5305. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-118 lists entries of UNTDID 5305; CEN rule BR-CL-17 enforces that list.

terms.name: VAT category rate
terms.description: VAT rate of this breakdown line, as a percentage.
notes: XRechnung 3.0.2 restricts this term to 1..1; this registry records the EN 16931-1 cardinality.

terms.name: VAT exemption reason text
terms.description: Textual reason why the amounts in this breakdown line are exempt from VAT or not subject to it.

terms.name: VAT exemption reason code
terms.description: Coded reason why the amounts in this breakdown line are exempt from VAT or not subject to it.
notes: Code list VATEX. Justification: Table 2 of EN 16931-1 points BT-121 at a list the Connecting Europe Facility publishes and keeps, and CEN rule BR-CL-22 names that list CEF VATEX.

terms.name: ADDITIONAL SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS
terms.description: Group referencing a supporting document that backs the claims made in the invoice.

terms.name: Supporting document reference
terms.description: Reference that identifies the supporting document.

terms.name: Supporting document description
terms.description: Textual description of the supporting document.

terms.name: External document location
terms.description: Internet address where the external supporting document can be retrieved.

terms.name: Attached document
terms.description: Supporting document embedded in the invoice as a binary object, with mime code and file name.
notes: The BT-x-y style is the numbering implementers commonly use for supplementary components. It could not be verified against CEN/TS 16931-3-2 or CEN/TS 16931-3-3, which are outside the free-access licence and were not obtained for this project. EN 16931-1 Table 2 lists the components without an id, so the component id here is an informative label and 'role' is the normative-facing member.

terms.name: INVOICE LINE
terms.description: Group carrying one invoice line.

terms.name: Invoice line identifier
terms.description: Identifier of the invoice line, unique within the invoice.

terms.name: Invoice line note
terms.description: Free-text note about the invoice line.

terms.name: Invoice line object identifier

components.name: Invoice line object identifier identification scheme identifier

terms.description: Identifier of an object the invoice line is based on, given by the seller.
notes: The BT-x-y style is the numbering implementers commonly use for supplementary components. It could not be verified against CEN/TS 16931-3-2 or CEN/TS 16931-3-3, which are outside the free-access licence and were not obtained for this project. EN 16931-1 Table 2 lists the components without an id, so the component id here is an informative label and 'role' is the normative-facing member.

The identification scheme of BT-128 is taken from a restriction of UNTDID 1153; rule BR-CL-07 of the CEN validation artefacts (EN16931-UBL-codes.sch, eInvoicing-EN16931 1.3.16) fixes it. schemeList records the name for documentation: membership of a code list is a business rule and is not checked by the structural layers.

terms.name: Invoiced quantity
terms.description: Quantity of items invoiced on this line.
notes: EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019/AC:2020 states that the number of fraction digits of this semantic data type is not limited; Table 26 does not restrict this term.

EN 16931-1 Table 2 neither permits nor forbids a negative value for this term. The informative example A.1.6 of the standard (negative invoice line) uses one, so an implementation should be prepared for it; this is an observation about the standard’s examples, not a rule of Table 2.

terms.name: Invoiced quantity unit of measure code
terms.description: Unit of measure code for the invoiced quantity, from UN/ECE Recommendation 20 with the Recommendation 21 extension.
notes: Code list UN/ECE Recommendation 20 with Rec 21 extension. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-130 refers to the lists of UN/ECE Recommendation 20 and UN/ECE Recommendation 21; CEN rule BR-CL-23 enforces Recommendation 20 with the Recommendation 21 extension.

terms.name: Invoice line net amount
terms.description: Net amount of the invoice line, after line allowances and charges and excluding VAT.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: Referenced purchase order line reference
terms.description: Identifier of the purchase order line this invoice line refers to.

terms.name: Invoice line Buyer accounting reference
terms.description: Textual reference telling the buyer which ledger account to book this invoice line to.

terms.name: INVOICE LINE PERIOD
terms.description: Group giving the period this invoice line relates to.

terms.name: Invoice line period start date
terms.description: First day of the invoice line period.

terms.name: Invoice line period end date
terms.description: Last day of the invoice line period.

terms.name: INVOICE LINE ALLOWANCES
terms.description: Group carrying an allowance that applies to this invoice line.

terms.name: Invoice line allowance amount
terms.description: Amount of the invoice line allowance, without VAT.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: Invoice line allowance base amount
terms.description: Base amount the invoice line allowance percentage is applied to.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: Invoice line allowance percentage
terms.description: Percentage applied to the base amount to derive the invoice line allowance amount.

terms.name: Invoice line allowance reason
terms.description: Textual reason for the invoice line allowance.

terms.name: Invoice line allowance reason code
terms.description: Coded reason for the invoice line allowance, from UNTDID 5189.
notes: Code list UNTDID 5189. Justification: Table 2 of EN 16931-1 names that list for BT-140, and CEN rule BR-CL-19 carries the same set of codes.

terms.name: INVOICE LINE CHARGES
terms.description: Group carrying a charge that applies to this invoice line.

terms.name: Invoice line charge amount
terms.description: Amount of the invoice line charge, without VAT.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: Invoice line charge base amount
terms.description: Base amount the invoice line charge percentage is applied to.
notes: EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 allows at most two fraction digits for this amount.

terms.name: Invoice line charge percentage
terms.description: Percentage applied to the base amount to derive the invoice line charge amount.

terms.name: Invoice line charge reason
terms.description: Textual reason for the invoice line charge.

terms.name: Invoice line charge reason code
terms.description: Coded reason for the invoice line charge, from UNTDID 7161.
notes: Code list UNTDID 7161. Justification: Table 2 of EN 16931-1 names that list for BT-145, and CEN rule BR-CL-20 carries the same set of codes.

terms.name: PRICE DETAILS
terms.description: Group carrying the price information for the item on this invoice line.

terms.name: Item net price
terms.description: Price of one item unit excluding VAT, after subtracting the item price discount.
notes: EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019/AC:2020 states that the number of fraction digits of this semantic data type is not limited; Table 26 does not restrict this term.

terms.name: Item price discount
terms.description: Discount subtracted from the item gross price to arrive at the item net price.
notes: EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019/AC:2020 states that the number of fraction digits of this semantic data type is not limited; Table 26 does not restrict this term.

terms.name: Item gross price
terms.description: Unit price excluding VAT before the item price discount is subtracted.
notes: EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019/AC:2020 states that the number of fraction digits of this semantic data type is not limited; Table 26 does not restrict this term.

terms.name: Item price base quantity
terms.description: Number of item units the item price applies to.
notes: EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019/AC:2020 states that the number of fraction digits of this semantic data type is not limited; Table 26 does not restrict this term.

terms.name: Item price base quantity unit of measure code
terms.description: Unit of measure code for the item price base quantity; must match the invoiced quantity unit.
notes: The KoSIT XRechnung semantic-model XSD names this element “Item price base quantity unit of measure”.

Code list UN/ECE Recommendation 20 with Rec 21 extension. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-150 requires the same unit code list as BT-130; CEN rule BR-CL-23 enforces Recommendation 20 with the Recommendation 21 extension.

terms.name: LINE VAT INFORMATION
terms.description: Group carrying the VAT information that applies to the item on this invoice line.

terms.name: Invoiced item VAT category code
terms.description: VAT category code that applies to the invoiced item, from UNTDID 5305.
notes: Code list UNTDID 5305. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-151 lists entries of UNTDID 5305; CEN rule BR-CL-18 enforces that list for line level tax categories.

terms.name: Invoiced item VAT rate
terms.description: VAT rate that applies to the invoiced item, as a percentage.

terms.name: ITEM INFORMATION
terms.description: Group describing the goods or services invoiced on this line.

terms.name: Item name
terms.description: Name of the invoiced item.

terms.name: Item description
terms.description: Textual description of the invoiced item.

terms.name: Item Seller's identifier
terms.description: Identifier the seller uses for the invoiced item.

terms.name: Item Buyer's identifier
terms.description: Identifier the buyer uses for the invoiced item.

terms.name: Item standard identifier

components.name: Item standard identifier identification scheme identifier

terms.description: Item identifier from a registered standard scheme, with a mandatory scheme identifier.
notes: The BT-x-y style is the numbering implementers commonly use for supplementary components. It could not be verified against CEN/TS 16931-3-2 or CEN/TS 16931-3-3, which are outside the free-access licence and were not obtained for this project. EN 16931-1 Table 2 lists the components without an id, so the component id here is an informative label and 'role' is the normative-facing member.

The identification scheme of BT-157 is taken from the ISO 6523 ICD list; rule BR-CL-21 of the CEN validation artefacts (EN16931-UBL-codes.sch, eInvoicing-EN16931 1.3.16) fixes it. schemeList records the name for documentation: membership of a code list is a business rule and is not checked by the structural layers.

terms.name: Item classification identifier

components.name: Item classification identifier identification scheme identifier
Item classification identifier identification scheme version identifier

terms.description: Item classification code from a classification scheme, with a mandatory scheme identifier and optional scheme version.
notes: The BT-x-y style is the numbering implementers commonly use for supplementary components. It could not be verified against CEN/TS 16931-3-2 or CEN/TS 16931-3-3, which are outside the free-access licence and were not obtained for this project. EN 16931-1 Table 2 lists the components without an id, so the component id here is an informative label and 'role' is the normative-facing member.

The identification scheme of BT-158 is taken from the UNTDID 7143 list; rule BR-CL-13 of the CEN validation artefacts (EN16931-UBL-codes.sch, eInvoicing-EN16931 1.3.16) fixes it. schemeList records the name for documentation: membership of a code list is a business rule and is not checked by the structural layers.

terms.name: Item country of origin
terms.description: Country the item originates from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
notes: Code list ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Justification: EN 16931-1 Table 2 usage note for BT-159 refers to the EN ISO 3166-1 maintenance agency; CEN rule BR-CL-15 enforces ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

terms.name: ITEM ATTRIBUTES
terms.description: Group carrying one additional attribute of the invoiced item.

terms.name: Item attribute name
terms.description: Name of the item attribute.

terms.name: Item attribute value
terms.description: Value of the item attribute.
